blocks.title: Answers you can click, fill in and explore
blocks.description: When a view says more than a paragraph, the AI builds it right in the conversation: a comparison matrix, a form, a dashboard or a small interactive tool. It follows your theme and replies to the AI when you act.

items.label: AI tools
items.description: Ready-made components, or a fully custom view

items.label: form controls
items.description: Text, dropdown, date, chips, switch, slider and more

items.label: chart types
items.description: Bar, line, pie, doughnut, radar and more

showcase.user_prompt: Compare Rust and Go for a new backend service.
showcase.assistant_reply: Here is a side-by-side matrix scored across 12 dimensions, with a code comparison tab and a picker that weighs your own constraints. Open any row for the reasoning.

blocks.title: From a wall of text to something you can use

left.title: Plain text reply
items: Long lists and tables as Markdown
You re-type your answers in the next message

right.title: With Vetta Generative UI
items: Cards, columns and tabs that group the answer
Forms and buttons: your choice goes back to the AI
KPI tiles and charts for numbers and trends
Calculators and what-if tools you can try

items.title: Forms
items.description: Text, number, date, dropdown, multi-choice chips, radio, checkbox, switch and slider. Required fields are checked before anything is sent.

items.title: Quick replies
items.description: Offer a few options as buttons. One click sends your pick as the next message.

items.title: Data views
items.description: KPI tiles, tables, property lists, progress bars and Chart.js charts.

items.title: Layouts
items.description: Cards, weighted columns and tabs, nested up to three levels, for dashboards and master-detail views.

items.title: Custom views
items.description: Calculators, simulators and diagrams, with Vetta-styled controls and optional Tailwind and Chart.js built in.

items.title: Isolated by design
items.description: Custom views run in a sandbox with no access to Vetta, your files or network requests. Anything they want to send is shown to you first.

items.title: Install and enable
items.description: Grant the permissions it asks for. No account or key is needed.

items.title: Ask in your own words
items.description: Say "compare these in a table", "ask me in a form" or "build a calculator". The AI also picks a view by itself for visual answers.

items.title: Use it in place
items.description: Fill in forms and click buttons right in the reply. Your answer goes back as your next message, and a submitted form stays marked as submitted.

blocks.content: Views appear in regular and project conversations, not in automations or chat gateways. Custom views can load scripts and images from the web but cannot fetch data, so the AI writes the data into the page.
